what_survives_of_the_old_finding: an offline re-entry (full reload) on the held generation lands on the NEXT generation even though the page never reconnected -- that part of the A reading is reproduced on the new base and is now the cell's live content
the partial-deploy control still bricks the client (0 characters), which is the DEPLOY_BUNDLE_RETENTION tooth
what_does_not_survive: 'in-app movement is lost on the never-reconnected generation' -- with the modal closed by its own close control, 3 of 3 destinations open offline on that generation
instrument_limit_this_erratum_exposes: Playwright's setOffline(true) does not stop the service worker's own update fetch, so this arm cannot distinguish 'the device never reconnected' from 'the device reconnected for the worker only'. The A cell therefore keeps its direction-reversal reading but loses any claim about what a truly radio-off device would do.
method: both sides were read from bytes, not from memory: the WAS side is the published blob fetched by its 40-hex id and re-hashed, the NOW side is this package's own artifact
